articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Why Li Auto (LI) Is Up 5.8% After March Delivery Rebound And New EV-Tech Unveiling. In March 2026, Li Auto reported deliveries of 41,053 vehicles, lifting cumulative deliveries to 1,635,357 as production bottlenecks eased and the Li i6 alone surpassed 24,000 monthly units. The company’s unveiling of its MindVLA autonomous driving foundation model at NVIDIA GTC 2026, alongside plans to launch an all-new Li L9 in the second quarter, highlights a push to pair higher volumes with in-house software and hardware advances.
